facts.fact: 网站设计师一听就明白她要的是「那种网站」，加收保密费并问她有没有装 VPN。
facts.anchor: Web designer: So it is that type of website. It will be an extra charge for discretion. Do you have a VPN set up for this?

facts.fact: Cinnamon 完全不懂为什么要防黑客、VPN 是什么东西。
facts.anchor: Confusion percolates through me at why my website would be hacked and why I would need a VPN.

facts.fact: 设计师强烈反对她放作品照片和家庭地址，让她只写城市。
facts.anchor: Web designer: no pictures!! No home address!! Use city.

facts.fact: 设计师要求先配 VPN 和安全邮箱，并用加密货币付款。
facts.anchor: Web designer: Stop, please. Let me set up your VPN first. I’ll set you up a secure email as well. Can you send my payment via crypto?

facts.fact: Cinnamon 同意设计师远程控制她的电脑代为付款。
facts.anchor: A few beats later, a pop up appears on my screen and I agree to let him have control.

facts.fact: 她把完整信用卡号、有效期、安全码和邮编直接发进了聊天窗。
设计师提醒她永远别把卡片信息发给任何人。
facts.anchor: Web designer: Please don’t ever send that to anyone else.

facts.fact: 她抱着紫色青蛙想起十六年前妈妈去世的那天，自己手里也攥着它。
facts.anchor: And sixteen years ago, the day my mom died, I was holding it too.

facts.fact: 她问过女警关于 Orzo 的下落：当时屋里只有她、Herb、另一个女人和她的妈妈。
facts.anchor: When I asked the police officer about him, she had said I was the only one in the house besides Herb, another woman, and my mom.

facts.fact: 多年后她试图寻找 Orzo，他却像幽灵一样查无踪迹。
facts.anchor: And when, years later, I tried to hunt him down, it was as if he were a ghost.
